shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Native dialog elevation above the bookshelf.

motion.name: dialog-reveal
motion.purpose: Clip-path inset changes from 0 0 8% 0 to 0 on opening; disabled with reduced motion.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Dialog control background transition; disabled with reduced motion.

components.name: Reading action
components.description: Brown reading anchor opens a new tab; the preview omits a book URL.
components.html: 開始閱讀
components.css: .ds-reading { font: 14px/1.5 Arial, "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #b9aaa0; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: #80563d; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; background: #80563d; color: #fff; border-color: #80563d; } .ds-reading:hover { background: #68432f; border-color: #68432f; } .ds-reading:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #80563d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reading:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-reading { transition: none; } }

components.name: Reroll control
components.description: Outlined reroll button remains beside the reading action and is disabled while drawing.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-reroll"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" width="20" height="20"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="3"/><path d="M7.5 7.5h.01M16.5 7.5h.01M12 12h.01M7.5 16.5h.01M16.5 16.5h.01" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>重骰</button>
components.css: .ds-reroll { font: 14px/1.5 Arial, "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #b9aaa0; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: #80563d; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out;  } .ds-reroll:hover { background: #f5efeb; } .ds-reroll:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #80563d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reroll:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-reroll { transition: none; } }  .ds-reroll svg { flex: none; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Directly visible underlined action for copying or native bookshelf operations.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font: 14px/1.5 Arial, "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #b9aaa0; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: #80563d; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; padding: 6px 0; min-height: 36px; border: 0; background: transparent; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #f5efeb; color: #4e3020; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #80563d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition: none; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-secondary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Close control
components.description: Icon button closes the native dialog and supplies an accessible name.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-close" aria-label="關閉"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" width="20" height="20"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-close { font: 14px/1.5 Arial, "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #b9aaa0; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: #80563d; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; border: 0; min-width: 40px; padding: 8px; color: #666; background: transparent; } .ds-close:hover { background: #f5efeb; } .ds-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #80563d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-close:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-close { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: Extend the existing BOOKWALKER bookshelf rather than introducing a new brand. Use compact controls, white surfaces, brown actions, and the original site's book metadata language. The user's pinned visual direction is the authority.
dos: Do keep the current bookshelf scope visible.
Do preserve factual titles, authors, dates, and original site-action labels.
Do keep secondary actions visible without an expansion control.
donts: Don't add decorative containers or unrelated brand elements.
